userStories.title: Create User Agreements Database Schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to store user agreement acceptances so we can track legal acknowledgments.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Supabase migration file in supabase/migrations/ for user_agreements table

Table columns: id (UUID primary key), user_id (UUID references auth.users), role (text: bookie or player), version (text), accepted_at (timestamptz), ip_address (text nullable), user_agent (text nullable)
Add RLS policy: users can only SELECT their own agreements (user_id = auth.uid())
Add RLS policy: authenticated users can INSERT their own agreements
Add RLS policy: no UPDATE or DELETE allowed (immutable)
Document migration in SUPABASE_MIGRATIONS.md
Typecheck passes

This app is provided for record-keeping and entertainment purposes only. Booki is not a licensed sportsbook, gambling operator, or financial institution.

By continuing, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old (or the legal age in your jurisdiction) and accept these terms.'

userStories.title: Create submit_bet Edge Function
userStories.description: As a player, my bet submissions must be validated and created server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/submit_bet/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS request for CORS preflight
Extract and validate JWT from Authorization header to get user_id
Accept JSON body: event_id, market_id, side (a or b), odds (Int), stake (Decimal string), player_id, bookie_id, idempotency_key
Validate: event exists and is not locked (start_time > now or status != locked)
Check idempotency_key - if exists, return cached response
Insert bet record with status 'pending', needsSync false
Store idempotency key with response
Return JSON: { success: true, bet: <created bet object> }
Return appropriate error responses for validation failures
Typecheck passes (Deno)

userStories.title: Create accept_bet Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, accepting a bet must be server-authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/accept_bet/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS request for CORS
Extract user_id from JWT
Accept JSON body: bet_id, idempotency_key
Validate: bet exists, bet.bookie_id matches user's bookie record, bet.status is 'pending'
Check idempotency - return cached response if key exists
Update bet status to 'accepted', set accepted_at timestamp
Store idempotency key
Return { success: true, bet: <updated bet> }
Return error if bet already accepted/declined/graded/settled
Typecheck passes (Deno)

userStories.title: Create grade_bet Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, grading a bet must be server-authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/grade_bet/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS for CORS
Extract user_id from JWT
Accept JSON body: bet_id, outcome (win, loss, push, void), idempotency_key
Validate: bet exists, belongs to bookie, status is 'accepted' (not already graded or settled)
Check idempotency
Update bet with outcome field
Store idempotency key
Return { success: true, bet: <updated bet> }
Typecheck passes (Deno)

userStories.title: Create settle_bet Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, settling a bet must atomically update bet status and create ledger entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/settle_bet/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS for CORS
Extract user_id from JWT
Accept JSON body: bet_id, idempotency_key
Validate: bet is graded (has outcome), not already settled
Check idempotency
Calculate payout based on outcome: win = stake * odds profit, loss = -stake, push = 0, void = 0
In transaction: update bet.status to 'settled', insert ledger_entry for player with calculated amount
Store idempotency key
Return { success: true, bet: <updated bet>, ledger_entry: <created entry> }
Typecheck passes (Deno)

userStories.title: Create adjust_balance Edge Function
userStories.description: As a bookie, manual balance adjustments must be server-authoritative with required reason.
acceptanceCriteria: Create supabase/functions/adjust_balance/index.ts
Handle OPTIONS for CORS
Extract user_id from JWT
Accept JSON body: player_id, amount (Decimal string, positive or negative), reason (required string), idempotency_key
Validate: player belongs to bookie, reason is not empty
Check idempotency
Insert ledger_entry with type 'adjustment', amount, reason, player_id, bookie_id
Store idempotency key
Return { success: true, ledger_entry: <created entry> }
Typecheck passes (Deno)
